title: Extend compatible neighbourhood evaluations to a module skyscraper morphism
statement:
Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space, meaning a topological space with a sheaf of commutative rings, and $x\in X$. Let $\mathcal G$ be a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and let $A$ be a module over the stalk ring $\mathcal O_{X,x}$, with germ maps $r\mapsto r_x$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. Write $i_{x,*}A$ for the module skyscraper of [def-pc-ringed-module-skyscraper], with sections $A$ on opens containing $x$, zero otherwise, and scalars acting through germs. Suppose that for every open $U
i x$ an additive map $e_U:\mathcal G(U)	o A$ is given, satisfying $e_U(rs)=r_xe_U(s)$ and $e_V(s|_V)=e_U(s)$ for $x\in V\subseteq U$. There is a unique morphism $E(e):\mathcal G	o i_{x,*}A$ whose component on $U
i x$ is $e_U$ and whose component on $U
ot
i x$ is the zero map. For a morphism $g:\mathcal G'	o\mathcal G$ of module sheaves, the family $(e g)_U=e_U\circ g_U$ satisfies the same hypotheses and $E(e g)=E(e)\circ g$. For an $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-linear map $h:A	o A'$, the family $(h e)_U=h\circ e_U$ also satisfies the hypotheses and $E(h e)=i_{x,*}h\circ E(e)$.
